content.comment_body: Where can I find the article number for the [product_name] [version_no]?

[company_name] has not assigned new article numbers for the latest [version_no] series. For purchases, please use the current article numbers. Delivery of the new series will begin as older models are sold out. If your supplier no longer has the older models, you'll automatically receive the new series.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'How many [product_name] [version_no] as Modbus can be connected?'. Best regards [user_name]
